candidate_works.title: Star Trek: Picard: The Dark Veil
candidate_works.creator: James Swallow
candidate_works.synopsis: The publisher situates the USS Titan during the Federation's halted Romulan evacuation after an attack on Mars. Riker's crew investigates a border crisis involving a secretive alien species and a Tal Shiar plot, while collaborating uneasily with a Romulan captain to avert broader conflict.

candidate_works.title: Star Trek: Picard: Rogue Elements
candidate_works.creator: John Jackson Miller
candidate_works.synopsis: The publisher follows Cristóbal Rios after his break with Starfleet as he tries to establish himself as an independent freighter captain. Debt and unwanted partnerships draw La Sirena through criminal networks, treasure seekers, and an old mystery years before his meeting with Picard.

candidate_works.title: Star Trek: Picard: Firewall
candidate_works.creator: David Mack
candidate_works.synopsis: The publisher places Seven of Nine two years after Voyager returns, when her application to Starfleet fails. She considers joining the Fenris Rangers, but this new direction threatens her bond with Admiral Janeway and the life she has known.

candidate_works.title: Pliable Truths
candidate_works.creator: Dayton Ward
candidate_works.synopsis: Amid Cardassia's withdrawal from Bajor, the publisher describes Picard mediating tense negotiations at Terok Nor while Ro Laren receives word from someone believed dead. The Enterprise crew confronts a hidden threat that could ruin the fragile prospects for peace.

candidate_works.title: Star Trek: Discovery: Somewhere to Belong
candidate_works.creator: Dayton Ward
candidate_works.synopsis: The publisher follows Discovery's crew as they adjust to a distant-future Federation weakened by the Burn. A distress call after another reconnection mission unexpectedly links back to their twenty-third-century past and draws them into new danger.

candidate_works.title: Revenant
candidate_works.creator: Alex White
candidate_works.synopsis: The publisher follows Jadzia Dax into a favor for a longtime Trill acquaintance: bringing the commissioner's granddaughter home from a resort casino. The young woman's unsettling transformation turns a routine errand into a search through old secrets.
